name: R007-misdreavus-pain-split-low
why: Challenge 7. The opponent leads Misdreavus (set 374: Pain Split, Shadow Ball, Confuse Ray, Thunder Wave; speed 105, HP 167). The player leads Ludicolo (set 688; speed 90, slower) with Toxic and Leech Seed: Toxic (turn 1) and Leech Seed (turn 2) take 10, 40, 50 HP at the ends of turns 1-3, so Misdreavus has about 40 percent at the start of turn 4. Ludicolo keeps 80 percent or more (Misdreavus's Shadow Ball does at most 21 percent; Leftovers and Leech Seed heal). Every AI turn the AI scores Pain Split through AI_CV_PainSplit: target >= 80 percent, Misdreavus not slower, so the last return of runCvPainSplit runs (the first piece, from turn 1); with Misdreavus at 40 percent or less it gives +1 (the second piece). Toxic / Leech Seed are repeated in case one misses; then Double Team.
